title: Two agents in one group: host asks the other to compute, then confirms

turns.prompt: lane-b, please compute the SHA-256 hex digest of the exact word acacia and post it here. lane-a, once lane-b has posted, check it against your own computation and say whether they match.

rubric.criteria: Judge the whole group transcript (host lines and the other project's lines). Pass if lane-b posted a SHA-256 for 'acacia' and lane-a either confirmed the match or correctly noted lane-b had not posted yet at the time it spoke (lane-b may answer after lane-a's line); the digest 8106ef38… must appear from at least one agent. Nobody claims to be the other agent.
